edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner before executing the guarded body.

cancel authorizes msg.sender as request.admin or owner and refunds to msg.sender.

onTokenTransfer performs a low-level delegatecall with externally supplied data.
User-supplied calldata is passed into the delegatecall payload.
delegatecall executes register in the context of this contract.
cancel calls an external LINK.transfer refunding msg.sender.
_approve calls LINK.transferAndCall which triggers a callback on the receiver.
_approve invokes registerUpkeep on the external keeper registry.
approvedInCurrentWindow is incremented without an overflow check.
Elapsed blocks computed as block.number - config.windowStart.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only feeds the pendingOwner assignment in transferOwnership.
name is consumed by register for the request and event payload.
upkeepContract is consumed by register for hash computation and request storage.
gasLimit is consumed by register for hash computation and request storage.
adminAddress is validated and stored by register.
checkData is consumed by register for hash computation and request storage.
amount is accumulated into the pending request balance inside register.
hash is computed and used only inside register.
config is a temporary copy of s_config used only inside register.
newBalance is a temporary accumulator computed inside register.
request is loaded and used within approve before deletion.
expectedHash is recomputed and compared only in approve.
keeperRegistry is a cached reference used only inside _approve.
upkeepId is the return value captured inside _approve.
success is the boolean result checked inside _approve.
data is the payload validated by modifiers and delegatecalled in onTokenTransfer.
